Riyadh Financial District Faces Houthi Attack | WION News
Iran-backed Houthis claim six military operations against Saudi Arabia, targeting Riyadh's Khalid International Airport, Aramco oil facilities and Saudi military positions. The group says it used ballistic missiles, cruise missiles and drones in retaliation for alleged Saudi strikes on Yemen. Houthi spokesperson Yahya Saree also accused Riyadh of carrying out 105 attacks in 24 hours. Meanwhile, Yemen's government forces claim to have pushed back Houthi fighters near Marib.
